answer: Locks are written down in falcon, expire in atlas, and dune lists each expiry. An adversary running 28 aliases therefore needs 138 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2898 identities would post 815 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
